findings.title: Vite development server exposes private .local files and generated DB credentials
findings.reproduction: With pnpm dev on API4311/Web5174, mode0600 benign .local/review/public-canary.json: GET /@fs/<absolute-workspace>/.local/review/public-canary.json, ?raw, ?import, ?raw&import, with Origin http://127.0.0.1:5174 and http://127.0.0.1:51999.
findings.actual: All eight requests returned200 and contained fake marker; other localhost origin received matching ACAO. Plain/raw bytes exactly matched private file. Real secrets were never read/requested.
findings.expected: Private .local files and generated credentials must never be served to browser clients in development; unrelated localhost origins should not be granted private-file read permissions.
findings.affectedScope: Documented pnpm db:local init + pnpm dev workflow; .local/postgres/ownership.json contains plaintext DB bootstrap password. All other private .local state is under same broad allow list. Express API security middleware does not guard Vite /@fs.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly deny whole .local tree and retain default secret protections; constrain dev file-serving to required frontend/shared code, narrow allowed dev origins, and add actual Vite-server canary regression covering plain/raw/import, other-localhost origins and legitimate shared-package loading.

nonblockingRecords.title: Pinned inherited Sharp and transitive esbuild retain scoped advisories
nonblockingRecords.reproduction: pnpm audit --json (exit1), using frozen pnpm lockfile.
nonblockingRecords.actual: Three high Sharp0.34.5 advisories; one low esbuild Windows standalone serve advisory. Audit is not globally clean.
nonblockingRecords.expected: Dependency risk must be recorded, bounded and re-evaluated before affected untrusted input/server surfaces become reachable.
nonblockingRecords.affectedScope: Sharp remains diagnostic prototype CLI/golden tests; PNG container/signature/CRC/RGBA8 validation precedes decoding; API/Web do not import Sharp and no upload/remote image path exists. esbuild is used for transforms/builds, not standalone serve; current host Mac and CI Linux.
nonblockingRecords.recommendation: Track compatible dependency upgrade with existing four-PNG byte regression and native oracle; re-evaluate before any untrusted image/import/upload or Windows esbuild serve exposure.
